clips.actions: Real settings: QWERTZ + Auto, AZERTY + Auto, then separately select English/French/German override. Open actual Notes field after each chosen layout. Restore QWERTY/en.
assertions: Saved layout and languageChoice, accessible selected state
Bound IME layoutId and actual Y/Z or A/Q key output
German fur -> für and French ete -> été with real touches; assert complete editor results; suggestions use selected language
clips.limitation: Do not count a settings label as proof of dictionary correction.

clips.actions: Select Small/Normal/Large/XL through settings. Open real IME for measured small vs XL shots; restore Normal.
assertions: Saved selection and accessible selected state for all four
Same-width IME and larger measured height/key-cell height for XL than Small
Actual key presses still insert expected text at both sizes

clips.actions: On Black, choose Off then On, colours and brightness using genuine controls; show real IME glow. Show Auto control separately.
assertions: Persisted backlight mode/colour/level and actual glow/glowRgb on connected IME
On yields positive glow, Off zero; brightness slider changes value
Keep raw before/after frames and dimensions
clips.limitation: Auto sensor response only if existing emulator sensor is genuinely controllable through ordinary documented console access; otherwise settings-only, no simulated physical-light claim. Colour swatches lack labels: derive their bounds from live UI and verify saved value, never guess fixed coordinates.

clips.actions: Select Off, short click and Double tap; press Try the click; restore prior pattern.
assertions: Saved pattern and selected accessible state
Actual labelled Try the click button is pressed
clips.limitation: Settings interaction only; emulator cannot prove tactile feel or motor strength.

clips.actions: Configure disposable App, Link and Text slots through real UI. Type neutral snippet using real keys; save and reopen each assignment.
assertions: Shortcuts.get type/value/label match each saved choice
Cancel leaves assignment unchanged; clear removes test slot
No direct preferences mutation counts as UI configuration evidence

clips.actions: Hold right grid key plus configured letters. Text inserts neutral phrase; App launches a stock offline app; Link uses a harmless local settings URI only if registered and safely available.
assertions: Exact snippet content in Notes
Foreground/resumed component matches configured stock app
ACTION_VIEW resolved handler/foreground matches local Link URI, with no injected intent from test controller
clips.limitation: Preflight package visibility and resolveActivity for App and Link on exact guest. If no local safe Link handler, report gap; do not open tel/mail/geo, contact external hosts or fabricate a handler. Link action is distinct from an HTTP page-load claim.

clips.actions: Type neutral English phrase, tap actual suggestion and centre pad, demonstrate next word; double-space full stop and next sentence capital; compare US/UK spelling.
assertions: Real engine has expected candidate before tap; exact resulting editor text after each acceptance
Double-space yields full stop, next sentence starts capitalised
Saved spelling preference and actual configured engine spelling, plus deterministic candidate/output fixture
clips.limitation: Source-derived fixtures must be checked locally against bundled dictionaries before capture; never claim all corrections are guaranteed.

clips.actions: In disposable guest, add invented neutral word in Settings, show suggestion; remove it, add two words then Clear all with confirmation. Optionally type an unknown word twice to show automatic learning.
assertions: Language-specific learned file entries and visible list count change
Candidate includes added word and stops treating it as unknown
Remove and confirmed clear affect only staged guest words; automatic learning only claimed if actually observed
clips.limitation: No owner dictionary data; no broad file export.

clips.actions: Supplement existing clips with Alt lock/unlock, single Shift, picker scrolling by touch/trackpad, default emoji tone setting, emoticon conversion/undo, selected currency sign quick tap. Show Match phone control if useful.
assertions: Exact multi-symbol output with Alt lock; next letter returns after unlock
Uppercase single letter then lower case
Picker page/category indices change after actual gesture
Default tone preference and actual toned insertion
Exact text-to-emoji and undo results
Chosen currency label and actual sign output; no volume side effect on quick tap

independence: Separate @Test per supplemental shot; do not put appearance behind a failing typing recording. Per-shot state restore in finally; failed startup must not abort unrelated test methods.

dependency_gate.host: Existing aggregate preflight: official Ubuntu ffmpeg/ffprobe + acl, JDK17, Python stdlib, SDK platform36/build-tools35+36, API35 Google x86_64 image with ARM64 translation, emulator native libs, NDK27/CMake3.22.1, product fonts/emoji/EN-FR-DE dictionaries, disk budget. No new Python package.
dependency_gate.guest: sh, screenrecord AVC, screencap PNG, stat, cat (/proc/PID/stat readable), kill -INT, mkdir, rm, cp, settings/cmd/ime/am/pm/input, UID2000. Existing AVC/PNG decode smoke remains required. App/Link handlers and locale dictionaries must be checked before their shots. Probe /proc/self/stat state/starttime readability before product capture; aggregate failure rather than waiting for individual takes.
dependency_gate.export: Keep existing strict container validation, full FFmpeg decode, frame count/duration checks, original-byte hashes, per-action JSON flags and visual review. Add only exact supplemental filenames to export allowlist during implementation. Use verified connector file-reference-to-editor materialization route; never raw download URL in producer.

uncovered_runtime: Supplemental class implemented locally, not executed on Android. Hardware sensor/haptic/audio/performance claims excluded. Optional model unavailable/off. Browser onboarding or unresolved safe handler can fail only Link/App shot, without hiding remaining independent tests.
